# Red Mountain Photography

> Architectural, interior and real estate photography and property video by Tim Barber. Based in Telluride, Colorado. Works across the Colorado high country (Telluride, Mountain Village, Ridgway, Ouray, Aspen, Vail and beyond) and travels nationwide.

Red Mountain Photography is the architecture and real estate studio of Red Mountain Media. Clients are architects, builders, interior designers, real estate brokers, hotels, and owners and property managers of luxury vacation rentals (Airbnb, Vrbo and direct booking). Projects are quoted individually: listings by bedroom count, architectural and partial shoots by number of spaces. Photos are delivered in 8 to 10 days and video in about two weeks; rush processing is available depending on availability. Every company that uses the images needs its own license; multiple licensees get a discount and cost sharing is encouraged.

Contact: (970) 670-0846, or the quote request form at https://redmountainphotos.com/contact
